transcript: When you feel your chest heavy and congested, this kitchen remedy can help you breathe better. Cut one red onion, four cloves of garlic, one lemon sliced, a piece of fresh ginger and a cinnamon stick. Put everything in a pot with two litres of water. Let it boil for 10 minutes and strain it into a cup. Drink it warm. Red onion is a natural ex-spectrant. It loosens the mucus stuck deep in your lungs and pushes it out. Garlic releases a lisin which destroys the bacteria that keep the infection active. Lemon provides vitamin C that strengthens your defences and clears the airways. Ginger warms the lungs from within, opens the bronchial tubes and activates circulation so everything moves. And cinnamon soothes throat irritation and reduces inflammation in the airways. Together they calm dry coughs, loosen the most stubborn mucus and give your immune system a natural boost. Drink one cup in the morning and another at night. It is comforting and takes just minutes to prepare. In the first days you may cough more. Do not worry, your lungs are releasing what they have been holding on to. After about a week, your breathing opens up, your chest feels relieved and the cough fades. Save this recipe. But I want you to understand something. Your lungs do not get heavy only from colds or cold weather. In Chinese medicine, the lungs store grief, the losses you never cried, the emotions you swallowed. Every time you wanted to scream and stayed silent, all of that stayed in your lungs. That is why some people who never smoked still feel their chest heavy. It is not always infection. Sometimes it is accumulated sadness. This drink clears today's phlegm. But if the sadness remains, your lungs remain heavy. Write breathe in the comments if you are going to make this. And if you want to cleanse your lungs from the root, I have spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do it. And everything I know is inside the way back to calm. The link is in my profile.
